SessionBridge — better-session-view
https://github.com/ryangavin/better-session-view


WHAT'S IN HERE

  SessionBridge.amxd   the Max for Live device
  bridge.js            the Node half — the UI is baked into this file
  lom.js               the [v8] half, the only code that talks to Live

KEEP ALL THREE TOGETHER. The device loads bridge.js and lom.js by name from
beside itself. Move the folder, not the .amxd.


INSTALL

  1. Unzip this folder somewhere permanent — not a Downloads folder you clear
     out, and not the zip preview.
  2. In Live, drag SessionBridge.amxd onto any track. It's an audio effect with
     a straight passthrough, so it's inert on the signal path — the Master
     track is a fine home.
  3. Wait for the status line to read "connected to Live".
  4. Click "Open Session Manager". It opens http://127.0.0.1:17800 in your
     browser.


THE STATUS LINE

  starting…           patcher loaded, Node hasn't booted
  server up           Node is listening, the LOM handshake hasn't completed
  connected to Live   both halves talking

Stuck on either of the first two? Options > Max > Open Max Window. Every error
and every timing line lands there.


REQUIREMENTS

  Ableton Live 12 with Max for Live. Built against 12.4.3 Suite (Max 9.1.4).
  Nothing is downloaded at runtime and the server binds to 127.0.0.1 only.

  Only one copy of the device can run at a time — two would fight over port
  17800. A second instance posts a warning rather than crashing.
